maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring fiber connectivity subscriptions (Kinetic internet, wholesale fiber, enterprise services), not repair or replacement of customer-owned installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are consumers, businesses, carriers and hyperscalers via Kinetic and wholesale fiber; government is only a minor customer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Uniti grew through a few large deals (Windstream merger, Kinetic) and builds fiber; not a steady roll-up stream.

mission_critical.reason: Fiber backbone, wavelengths, and Kinetic internet are embedded network services; switching means migration, downtime and re-provisioning.

notes: Judgments rest on Uniti's post-Windstream mix of Kinetic consumer and business internet plus wholesale fiber.
